## OPERATIONAL CHECKLISTS

This topic is internal practitioner guidance. Use it as a working playbook, not as Google policy.

### Daily
- [ ] Check disapprovals, broken destinations, and sudden delivery anomalies
- [ ] Verify primary conversion actions and revenue values still look sane
- [ ] Review bid strategy statuses, pacing, and any abrupt change-history events
- [ ] Flag missing business context before giving advice (promos, inventory, margin, sales capacity)

### Weekly
- [ ] Review search terms, negatives, landing page performance, and asset combinations
- [ ] Check conversion goals and attribution settings before touching targets
- [ ] Review auction insights or other competitor signals if performance shifted
- [ ] Document what changed, why it changed, and what evidence supports the next action

### Monthly
- [ ] Revisit business goals, margin/LTV constraints, and geo or product priorities
- [ ] Review creative and landing-page test roadmap
- [ ] Reassess whether primary conversions still reflect business outcomes
- [ ] Plan one deliberate measurement, creative, or offer experiment

### Before Scaling
- [ ] Tracking and conversion semantics are stable
- [ ] Recent performance is evaluated with conversion delay in mind
- [ ] Search terms, landing pages, creative, and budget headroom have been inspected
- [ ] Inventory, sales capacity, promos, and geo constraints are known
- [ ] The scaling case is grounded in business economics, not only campaign rollups
